summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing (49.2 ms vs 77.5 ms CPU TorchScript), cut inference latency 5.2× with TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson, and profiled 8-bit LLM inference (TinyLlama 1.1B, ~55% less GPU memory) with pynvml. Wrote parallel programs in C/C++ and MPI with speedups up to 30× and trained a GPT-2 style transformer from scratch in PyTorch.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, a transformer-based document understanding model, in PyTorch with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through improved preprocessing and model tuning in the post-training pipeline.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Combined optimized homography stitching with concurrency and a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to raise PSNR from 65 to 86 over the baseline stitching pipeline.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels: ran at 49.2 ms vs 73.3 ms (uncoalesced GPU) and 77.5 ms (CPU TorchScript), a ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.
Applied memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to remove per-layer allocation overhead, reaching 1.5–2× speedup in convolution operations.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and LLM inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC: <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Cut vision inference latency 5.2× with TensorRT-optimized YOLO on NVIDIA Jetson (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) inside a voice-to-pick pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000×5000 pixel scenes using MPI.
Achieved up to 30× speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes); the dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers on a SLURM-managed cluster; achieved up to 10.49× speedup with 12 slave processes and measured up to 65% performance degradation from load imbalance.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch (multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, weight tying) with a custom training loop, early stopping, and perplexity evaluation.
